findings.location: CHANGELOG.md:139-150 (Fixed bullet on rehydration pointers); docs/cannot-do.md:774-779 (section 5, 'What Qompack does instead'); docs/release.md:232 (capability row for the pointer screen) and docs/release.md:210 ('D1 to D61'); docs/release-notes/v0.3.0.md:167-172
findings.issue: Four user-facing pages describe the D61(b)(2) screen that D63 replaced. That screen withheld free text only when it contained a rule's literal, a withheld name or an outside absolute path, and none of the four mentions the D63 whitelist HEAD actually runs. On HEAD a free-text summary is shown only when every token passes tokenSafe/plainTokenSafe/urlTokenSafe (internal/rehydrate/pathgate.go:1440-1620). So any command that holds a variable, a glob, a regex, a `%xx`, a backtick, a caret or a `name:` where a path may start is withheld, even when it names no rule literal or path. cannot-do section 5 also says the text is 'decoded and normalized', which is D61's wording: the code percent-decodes nothing. screenText (pathgate.go:2151) only strips ' " ` \ ^ and folds case, and a `%` before two hex digits withholds. D63 and D64 are cited only in docs/security.md:86/118 and ADR 0011. The capability table says it was written from D1-D61, and its row cites D61(b), the superseded rule. The w20-docs report's own open issue asked that the CHANGELOG Security entry, cannot-do section 5 and the capability row be re-checked against 19c; they never were.
findings.evidence: Overlay probe (go test -overlay with a scratch zz_audit_docs_test.go in internal/rehydrate, one Build per summary, root C:\q\proj, rules ./private/deny.txt ./.env ./secrets/** ./secret*). Each of these is WITHHELD although it names no rule literal, no withheld name and no outside path, so the documented rule predicts SHOWN: `find . -name "*.go"`, `git log --pretty=format:%h`, `echo $HOME`, `curl localhost:3000`, `echo a%41`. CHANGELOG.md:142-145 reads 'A free-text summary ... is screened: it is withheld when it contains a Read deny or ask rule's literal, the name or relative path of a path this build withholds, or an absolute path outside the project, and whenever the host's rules cannot be read.' cannot-do.md:775 reads 'withheld when, decoded and normalized, it contains ...'.
findings.fix: Rewrite the four passages to say what HEAD does. A free-text summary is shown only when the D63 whitelist proves every token safe and it names no absolute or escaping path, no rule literal and no withheld name. It over-withholds by design: variables, globs, regexes, `%` escapes and `name:` shapes such as `localhost:3000` and `format:%h` (D64(4)). Cite D63 and D64. Drop 'decoded'. Raise the capability table's range to D64 and cite D63 in its row. Add stale-claim rows to test/docs for 'decoded and normalized' and for the blacklist sentence.

nits.issue: The page says an http(s) URL is shown when it is 'built only from letters, digits and `- . _ ~ : / ? # @ & = +`'. In the code, each part after an `&` must be a plain token (urlTokenSafe, pathgate.go:1490-1497), so a `#` fragment or a `?` after an `&` withholds the URL. ADR 0011:1050-1054 states this correctly. The error over-withholds and leaks nothing.
nits.evidence: Probe: `curl https://example.com/a?b=c&d=e#x` WITHHELD; `curl https://example.com/a?b=c&d=e?f` WITHHELD; `curl https://example.com/a?b=c#x` SHOWN; `curl https://example.com/a?b=c&d=e` SHOWN.
nits.fix: Add ', and after an `&` only plain-token characters (no `?` or `#`)' to security.md:89.
